name: Wildebeest, zebra & large grazers
description: The great migration in one node. Functional group pooling the source's 'Topi' node - the white-bearded wildebeest, Burchell's zebra, topi, kongoni (hartebeest), Defassa waterbuck and roan antelope - measured together by the source study. Roughly 1.5 million wildebeest pass through the ecosystem each year.
